about: Reduced copy of the Vesuvius Challenge open-data catalog (https://vesuvius-challenge-open-data.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/metadata.json, read 31 Oct 2026): only PHerc0139's volume transform from 20250728140407 to 20260102150214, which rlcommon.catalog_matrix reads by default.
